## 📊 Collection Statistics | Metric | Count | |--------|-------| | **Total APIs** | **979** | | **Category** | **Video Scraping** | | **Last Updated** | 1/27/2026 |
--- ## 🤔 What Can You Build? This collection contains **979 ready-to-use video scraping APIs** that you can integrate directly into your applications. Whether you're building video downloaders, metadata extractors, transcript generators, or content analysis tools, these APIs provide the building blocks you need. **The possibilities are endless:** - 🎥 **Video Downloads** - Download videos from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and more platforms - 📊 **Metadata Extraction** - Extract titles, descriptions, thumbnails, durations, view counts, and engagement metrics - 📝 **Transcripts & Subtitles** - Generate transcripts, captions, and subtitles from video content - 🔍 **Video Search** - Search and discover videos across multiple platforms - 📈 **Analytics & Insights** - Analyze video performance, engagement, and trends - 🎬 **Playlist Management** - Extract and manage video playlists - 💬 **Comment Scraping** - Collect comments, likes, and user interactions - 🎵 **Audio Extraction** - Convert videos to MP3 and extract audio tracks - 🌐 **Multi-Platform Support** - Access APIs for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Vimeo, Twitch, and more **Each API is production-ready** - simply integrate it into your application and start building. No need to build scrapers from scratch or maintain complex infrastructure. Focus on what matters: creating amazing applications that solve real problems. --- ## 📚 Video APIs - [**Videos**](./videos-apis-979/) - 979 APIs for video scraping, downloading, metadata extraction, transcripts, and more --- ## 🎯 Popular Use Cases ### Video Download & Extraction - Download videos in HD/4K quality - Extract audio tracks (MP3 conversion) - Bulk video processing - Watermark-free downloads ### Metadata & Analytics - Extract video metadata (titles, descriptions, thumbnails) - Collect engagement metrics (views, likes, comments) - Analyze video performance - Track trending content ### Content Processing - Generate video transcripts - Extract subtitles and captions - Convert video to text - Multi-language support ### Platform-Specific Tools - **YouTube**: Channel scrapers, playlist extractors, comment collectors - **TikTok**: Video downloaders, profile scrapers, hashtag analyzers - **Instagram**: Post scrapers, story extractors, video downloaders - **Facebook**: Video metadata extractors, downloaders - **Vimeo**: Video scrapers, downloaders - **Twitch**: Stream recorders, video extractors --- ## 🚀 Getting Started 1. **Browse the APIs** - Check out the [Videos APIs](./videos-apis-979/) directory 2. **Choose an API** - Find the API that fits your needs 3. **Integrate** - Use the API endpoint in your application 4. **Build** - Create amazing video-related applications! --- ## 📖 Documentation Each API includes: - Detailed descriptions - Usage examples - Integration guides - Pricing information - Support resources --- ## 🤝 Contributing Found an API that should be added? Have suggestions for improvement? Contributions are welcome! --- ## 📄 License This repository is maintained for educational and development purposes. Please check individual API providers for their terms of service and usage policies. --- ## ⚠️ Disclaimer This repository is a collection of third-party APIs. Please ensure you comply with: - Terms of Service of the platforms you're scraping - Copyright and intellectual property laws - Rate limits and usage policies - Data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) Always use these APIs responsibly and ethically. ---
